android.desc:
Sleep Sounds Calm Relax Sounds is your peaceful companion for better sleep, relaxation, meditation, and focus. Choose from a variety of soothing sounds and create your own relaxing soundscape to help calm your mind, reduce everyday stress, and make bedtime more comfortable.

Whether you want to fall asleep faster, take a relaxing nap, block distracting background noise, or simply enjoy a quiet moment, Sleep Sounds Calm Relax Sounds gives you the sounds you need in one simple app.

Relaxing Sounds for Sleep & Rest

Enjoy a collection of calming sounds, including:-
* Rain and gentle storms
* Ocean waves and flowing water
* Birds and peaceful nature sounds
* Wind and relaxing ambience
* Fire and crackling sounds
* White noise and soothing background sounds
* Relaxing melodies and ambient sounds

Mix different sounds together and adjust their volume to create your own personalized atmosphere for sleeping, relaxing, studying, meditation, or concentration.

Features
* Create your own relaxing sound mixes
* Adjust the volume of each sound individually
* Use a sleep timer to stop sounds automatically
* Enjoy sounds while using other apps
* High-quality, soothing audio
* Works without an internet connection
* Perfect for sleep, meditation, relaxation, and focus

Let the calming sound of rain, waves, wind, nature, or white noise become part of your bedtime routine. Sleep Sounds Calm Relax Sounds helps you create a peaceful environment whenever you need to relax, or get ready for sleep.
